verdict.rationale: Circle's docs mention CPN's 'self-managed' vs 'managed' options where a business can 'operate your own stablecoin lifecycle, including custody, payouts, and compliance' or have 'Circle handle licensing, custody, compliance, treasury, and settlement on your behalf,' which gestures at a white-label stablecoin issuance capability, and Circle Mint lets 'qualified businesses' convert USD/USDC. But there is no dedicated, clearly-named issuance product page detailing minting mechanics, redemption workflows, and reserve management for a founder's OWN branded coin, nor explicit eligibility/gating criteria for that specific offering. Missing for 10: a named branded-stablecoin-issuance product page, concrete minting/redemption API docs for third-party issuers, explicit reserve-management/attestation details for issuer's own coin, and honestly-quoted eligibility/licensing gating for that product.
